Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: full-bleed background for a warm humorous hidden-object space-station game, Last Shift
Primary request: A cozy biology lab aboard a small space station, seen in FIRST PERSON at standing eye level from INSIDE the room. Landscape 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Scene: A broad workbench occupies the lower middle of the composition. Small scientific glassware, microscopes, seed drawers, pinned botanical notes with only indistinct pencil marks, a wall terrarium with tiny trailing greenery, and a rounded window showing quiet stars. Natural rich subtle clutter, with charming slightly improvised laboratory fittings.
Style: Watercolor washes on visibly fibrous rice paper, delicate pencil outlines, muted sage green, ochre, dusty indigo, warm creamy highlights, gentle low-contrast lighting. Cozy and softly humorous, beautifully illustrated, not photorealistic.
Composition: Immersive human eye-level room perspective with visible back wall, no exterior view of the room. Broad flat usable workbench top in lower middle. Leave two small clear spots on that workbench centered at 32% image width / 67% image height and 69% width / 65% height, suitable for placing small potted plant game sprites later. The clear spots should blend naturally into the bench without circles or markers.
Constraints: No freestanding potted plants anywhere on counters or floor; greenery only inside the wall terrarium. No visible character, hands, user interface, captions, logos, legible text, watermark, border, or margins. Absolutely not top-down, isometric, dollhouse or cutaway. Full bleed edge to edge.
